description:
To cure the Dragon King’s worsening illness, the Dragon Palace orders Bang-yul, a turtle beastman, to bring back a rabbit.

The soft-hearted Bang-yul only heads to the surface to fetch a small, cute rabbit after making the ministers promise to spare its life. However, the “rabbit” he encounters on land turns out to be a vicious man wielding a bloody club...

*“Looks like we have a little rat here.”  
“Wait, how on earth is that guy a rabbit?!”*

At first, Bang-yul was simply terrified of this intimidating rabbit. But as they travel together, he finds himself raising his voice and throwing a temper for the first time in his life. Before long, they end up tangling beneath the sheets, leaving his heart just as confused and restless.

Will the royal turtle Bang-yul be able to successfully complete his mission? *(Source: RIDI, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3864002829), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000127337)
